flow_overview: Document-contextualized Mashboot requirements grounded only in the 2010 Mashboot SRS.

requirements.text: The Mashbot web interface shall provide tabbed navigation for Dashboard, Create, Schedule, and Explore workflows.
requirements.rationale: Composed only from cited Mashboot PDF sections and numbered requirements; requires manual verification review.
requirements.parent_harvest_text:
Contextual source records: mashboot::2.1.2, mashboot::4

The user interface consists of a web front end with tabs to separate the various workflow areas. To create content, the user is provided with a calendar scheduling tool and a content editor. Additionally, there is a monitoring dashboard which gives the user a view on responses to the content in any given campaign. Finally, there is an explore view that gives the user a portal with which they can keep tabs on topics of interest in social media.

The user interface will consist of a tabbed navigation bar that unifies the sitewide navigation, as well as module specific navigation as needed. Tabs: Dashboard, Create, Schedule, Explore.

This view allows users to create campaigns and fill them with content. This view is also used when users need to edit an existing campaign. A user can add content via the add content button near the top of the view. This prompts the user to select the content type, populated by services the user currently has access to. It creates a section that allows the user to add individual elements of that content type, each individually scheduled. Each row allows the user to schedule, edit, or delete that content type.

requirements.text: The Schedule view shall let users drag content from the content bucket to the calendar, assign the dragged content a default go-live time of 12am on the selected day, and select scheduled content to assign a different go-live time.
requirements.rationale: Composed only from cited Mashboot PDF sections and numbered requirements; requires manual verification review.
requirements.parent_harvest_text:
Contextual source records: 2010 - mashboot::3.2::3.2.2/req-0530, mashboot::4.1.2

A schedule is a mapping of times to publishing actions. It may contain any actions a publisher can perform, and these actions are performed at the associated time.

Users can drag items from the left hand bucket of content to the calendar to schedule content. The content receives a default go-live time of 12am on the day it is dragged. The user may click scheduled content and assign a different time. The calendar manages when content goes live and visually represents actions taken on content, including when it is deleted. The user can page month to month to schedule content to any desired day.
